units.title: Global C² regularity of one Hermite class
units.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. Let \(H_j\) be the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial and put \(h_j(w)=[x\mapsto H_j(\langle w,x\rangle)]\in L^2(\gamma_E)\). For a finite set \(S\subset\mathbb N\) and real coefficients \(c_j\), put \(F_{S,c}(w)=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j(w)\). For every natural degree \(j\), the actual class map \(h_j\) is globally twice continuously Fréchet differentiable on all of \(E\).
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(j\) is arbitrary; the parameter vector is not restricted to the sphere.

steps.title: Specialize polynomial smoothness and lower the order
steps.text: Apply the polynomial theorem to the real image of \(H_j\). The class definition uses exactly the same membership witness, so the smooth map is the desired map. Smoothness implies \(C^2\).
